name: orion-infra Bicep

taskMap.github: azure/login (OIDC) + az deployment group what-if/create in run steps
taskMap.note: the monitoring step stays conditional on the deployMonitoring input

acceptedWarnings.why: The source gives these jobs no environment and keeps the credentials at repository level (Azure variable groups are not environment-scoped). Scoping them to a GitHub environment is a hardening choice for the reviewer; it would add approvals and deployment records the source does not have.

notes: Azure service connections orion-azure-dev/prod become OIDC identities (AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID): repository level for dev, the infra-prod environment for prod.
Environment infra-prod carries the approval and branch control of the source; configure them on the GitHub environment. Environment infra-dev has no checks.
Group orion-infra-config non-secret variables are exported as env; its ARM_CLIENT_SECRET secret is not referenced and not created.
The task analyser does not list the second AzureCLI@2 (inside a conditional insertion) but the same task is listed elsewhere in the file.
